Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff / next steps (post-demo recap)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the SOW. Quick answers from procurement side: 

- Preferred path: PO (our policy requires vendor onboarding for anything over $25k). We can do card for small one-off purchases but this will be a contracted pilot, so PO is the expected flow.
- Required documents: signed MSA or SOW, vendor W-9, SOC 2 Type II or equivalent security evidence, and invoice instructions (name/address/ remit).
- Timeline: procurement review + legal usually takes 7–10 business days once docs are submitted. We can expedite if the legal team is looped early.

I'll have procurement@acmecorp.com confirm the required vendor onboarding form and who signs the PO.

Also — side note: we're evaluating using AWS Marketplace for purchasing to speed procurement. Do you have a Marketplace listing or an AM who can help explain the marketplace invoicing vs direct PO?

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of IT Procurement | Acme Corp
(Procurement prefers emailed invoice + PO number)

Hey team — quick technical confirmation: for the 6-week pilot we can offer two flavors:

1) Hosted (Redwood API) with region restrictions and customer-managed API keys (fastest onboarding).
2) Private (VPC) pilot deployed into your cloud — requires additional setup and an order for Dedicated or Private. Longer lead time (~3–4 weeks).

If procurement wants marketplace ordering, both options can be reflected in the SOW but marketplace purchases are typically for hosted offerings. If you need VPC/on-prem, we'll need to scope Dedicated pricing and schedule a deployment kickoff.

I'll update the SOW language to call out hosted vs private pilot options and include a short checklist of prerequisites (network access, IAM contact, expected qps).

Cheers,
Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
